data.one_liner: Allows users to pick files with persistent permissions for reading and writing later.
data.what_it_does: A Flutter plugin enabling users to open, read, write back to, and create files on external media. It supports persistent permissions on Android and secure bookmarks on iOS.
use_when: You need to read and update files selected by the user across app restarts
You need to create new files on external storage via user prompts
avoid_when: You only need temporary sandboxed internal app storage
You need full desktop support beyond URL event listening
strengths: Supports persistent file permissions on Android and secure bookmarks on iOS
Handles open intents and file handlers from external apps
Allows creating new files with custom names and directory selection
weaknesses: MacOS support is limited to listening for URL events
Requires platform-specific configuration for file handlers and document browsers
data.setup_notes: Requires native configuration on iOS (plist keys) and Android (AndroidManifest intent filters) for file handlers.
